sources.text: Vaud, more formally Canton of Vaud, is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of ten districts; its capital city is Lausanne. Its coat of arms bears the motto "Liberté et Patrie" on a white-green bicolour.

sources.text: Regeneration (1830–1847): Liberal movements give many cantons new constitutions with popular sovereignty and freedom of the press.
sources.label: Key event · Regeneration

sources.text: Sonderbund and Sonderbund War (1845–1847): Seven Catholic cantons form a separate alliance (1845); the federal army under General Dufour defeats it in November 1847 in a short civil war.
sources.label: Key event · Sonderbund and Sonderbund War

sources.text: Federal Constitution: the federal state (1848): The Confederation becomes a federal state with a parliament of two chambers, the Federal Council and Bern as federal city.
sources.label: Key event · Federal Constitution: the federal state

sources.text: The Swiss franc (1850): The federal coinage act replaces the cantonal currencies with the franc.
sources.label: Key event · The Swiss franc
